ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: in the figure, the large circular ring is fixed on a horizontal tabletop, and the plane in which the circular ring lies is a vertical plane; the small ring is sleeved on the large circular ring, and its initial position is near the highest point of the large circular ring. Then reason: the small ring is constrained by the large circular ring and can only move along the large circular ring, so at any moment the direction of the instantaneous displacement of the small ring is along the tangent direction of the large circular ring. The problem states that the large circular ring is smooth and fixed, so the force exerted by the large circular ring on the small ring is only the constraint support force, with no friction force; this support force is along the normal direction of the large circular ring, that is, along the radial direction. According to the definition of work dW=F·ds, the direction of the support force is always perpendicular to the direction of the instantaneous displacement of the small ring, and the dot product is constantly zero, so during the entire process of sliding down, the force exerted by the large circular ring on the small ring does no work throughout.

method.method_draft: 从图中确认小环被约束在竖直圆形大环上运动，任意时刻小环的位移方向沿大圆环切线方向。由题文读取“大圆环光滑且固定”，因此大圆环对小环的作用力只有约束支持力，没有摩擦力；该支持力沿大圆环的法线方向，即沿半径方向。用功的定义 W=∫F·ds 判断：支持力方向始终与小环瞬时位移方向垂直，所以点积恒为零。因此在整个下滑过程中，大圆环对小环的作用力一直不做功。
